headline: prevent_destroy removed from the production data bucket — the guard was working, not broken
suppressed: CostCenter tag addition is cosmetic and safe — not reported.

findings.evidence_ref: data_stores.tf: lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true } block deleted from aws_s3_bucket.data
findings.explanation: prevent_destroy on a data bucket exists to catch plans that would destroy it. A CI plan failing because of this guard almost always means something in that plan *would* destroy the bucket — removing the guard unblocks CI by silencing the warning, not by fixing the underlying cause. Once merged, a future terraform apply could delete the bucket and its contents without any barrier.
